# Tweak catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tweaks-doc.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Event Horizon ships **89 tweaks** in 9 categories and **13 boost-ups**.

Every tweak has three PowerShell scripts in [`src/main/tweaks.js`](../src/main/tweaks.js):

- **apply** makes the change.
- **revert** restores the Windows default value (not necessarily the value you had before, see [Rollback](../README.md#rollback)).
- **check** reads the live state, which is what the toggle in the app shows.

Legend: ⟳ needs a reboot · ★ recommended · 👤 runs without administrator rights

## Presets

| Preset | Tweaks | What it includes |
|---|---|---|
| Lite | 62 | Recommended tweaks with no functional trade-off. Apply and forget. |
| Power | 65 | Everything in Lite plus medium-risk latency tweaks (MSI, Nagle, tick). |
| Max | 69 | Power plus VBS, HVCI and CPU-mitigation removal. Most performance, least security isolation. |

## FPS & Latency (20)

Frame pacing, input lag and scheduler priority for games.

| Tweak | Risk | Notes | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling**<br><sub>`hags`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ⟳ ★ | Lets a supported GPU (NVIDIA GTX 10-series or newer, AMD RX 5000 or newer) manage its own work queue, which can lower latency and CPU overhead. |
| **Enable Windows Game Mode**<br><sub>`game_mode`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ 👤 | Tells Windows to prioritise your game, pause Windows Update installs and background driver work while playing. |
| **Disable Game DVR & Xbox Game Bar capture**<br><sub>`gamedvr_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Stops Xbox Game Bar from continuously recording gameplay in the background, which costs GPU encode time and disk writes. |
| **Disable Fullscreen Optimizations globally**<br><sub>`fso_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ 👤 | Forces true exclusive fullscreen instead of the borderless hybrid, cutting input latency in many DX11 titles. |
| **Enable Optimizations for Windowed Games**<br><sub>`windowed_opt`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ 👤 | Windows 11 flip-model presentation for borderless games: lower latency and VRR/G-Sync support in windowed mode. |
| **Boost multimedia scheduler priority for games**<br><sub>`mm_games`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Raises the multimedia scheduler (MMCSS) "Games" task to high CPU and I/O priority for games that register with it. |
| **System responsiveness: 0% reserved for background**<br><sub>`sysresp`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | By default MMCSS reserves 20% of CPU time for low-priority work while multimedia tasks run. This lowers that reservation to the minimum. |
| **Foreground process priority boost (Win32PrioritySeparation)**<br><sub>`win32priority`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Sets short, fixed quantum with a 3:1 foreground boost (0x26) — the classic competitive-gaming scheduler setting. |
| **Allow high-resolution timer requests**<br><sub>`timer_res`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ⟳ ★ | Windows 11 throttles timer resolution for background windows; this lets games keep the 0.5 ms timer they ask for. |
| **Disable Dynamic Tick**<br><sub>`dynamic_tick`</sub> | 🟡 medium | ⟳ ★ | Stops the kernel from coalescing timer ticks to save power. Smoother frametimes on a desktop that never runs on battery. |
| **Use platform tick & remove forced HPET**<br><sub>`platform_tick`</sub> | 🟡 medium | ⟳ | Removes any forced HPET clock and uses the platform tick. Can lower DPC latency and micro-stutter on Intel boards. |
| **Disable mouse acceleration (1:1 raw input)**<br><sub>`mouse_accel`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ 👤 | Turns off "Enhance pointer precision" so every mouse count maps to the same distance. Requires sign-out to fully apply. |
| **Instant mouse hover response**<br><sub>`mouse_hover`</sub> | 🟢 safe | 👤 | Drops the tooltip / hover delay from 400 ms to 10 ms so UI reacts immediately. |
| **Fastest keyboard repeat rate & delay**<br><sub>`keyboard_rate`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ 👤 | Minimum repeat delay and maximum repeat speed for snappier key input. |
| **Disable Sticky / Filter / Toggle Keys shortcuts**<br><sub>`sticky_keys`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ 👤 | Never again get the Sticky Keys popup after spamming Shift mid-fight. |
| **Message Signaled Interrupts (MSI) for the GPU**<br><sub>`msi_gpu`</sub> | 🟡 medium | ⟳ ★ | Switches the display adapter to Message Signaled Interrupts instead of legacy line-based IRQs, which can reduce interrupt latency. |
| **Disable background Store apps**<br><sub>`background_apps_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ 👤 | Stops UWP apps from running, syncing and pushing notifications while you game. |
| **Disable Spectre / Meltdown CPU mitigations**<br><sub>`spectre_off`</sub> | 🔴 high | ⟳ | Removes kernel-level speculative-execution patches. Can recover CPU throughput in syscall-heavy workloads, at the cost of security hardening against speculative-execution attacks. |
| **Disable Virtualization-Based Security (VBS)**<br><sub>`vbs_off`</sub> | 🔴 high | ⟳ | Turns off the hypervisor layer Windows 11 enables by default, which costs FPS in many CPU-bound games. Also disables Hyper-V, WSL2, Windows Sandbox and Android apps. Reduces security isolation. |
| **Disable Memory Integrity (HVCI)**<br><sub>`hvci_off`</sub> | 🔴 high | ⟳ | Core Isolation memory integrity runs kernel code-integrity checks inside the hypervisor. Disabling it is a widely used FPS fix for CPU-bound games, but removes a security layer. |

## GPU (NVIDIA) (4)

Driver-level behaviour for NVIDIA GeForce cards.

| Tweak | Risk | Notes | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Disable NVIDIA telemetry**<br><sub>`nvidia_telemetry_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ NVIDIA only | Disables the NvTelemetryContainer service and the NvTmRep / profile-updater scheduled tasks. |
| **NVIDIA per-core DPC handling**<br><sub>`nvidia_dpc`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ⟳ ★ NVIDIA only | Sets RmGpsPsEnablePerCpuCoreDpc so the NVIDIA driver can spread deferred procedure calls across CPU cores instead of core 0. |
| **Stop Windows Update from replacing GPU drivers**<br><sub>`wu_driver_block`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Prevents Windows Update from replacing your GPU vendor driver with an older generic one. |
| **Keep the DirectX shader cache**<br><sub>`nvidia_shadercache_big`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Stops Disk Cleanup and Storage Sense from purging the D3D shader cache, so games do not recompile shaders after every cleanup (less first-load stutter). |

## Power & CPU (9)

Keep the CPU clocked up, unparked and responsive.

| Tweak | Risk | Notes | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Ultimate Performance power plan**<br><sub>`ultimate_plan`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Unhides and activates Microsoft's Ultimate Performance scheme: no core parking, no idle throttling, instant frequency ramps. |
| **Disable Power Throttling**<br><sub>`power_throttling_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Stops Windows from pushing background and "inactive" processes into energy-saving mode — your game is never inactive. |
| **Disable CPU core parking**<br><sub>`core_parking_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Keeps every CPU core unparked so there is no un-park latency when load spikes. |
| **Minimum processor state 100%**<br><sub>`min_proc_state`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Prevents the CPU from dropping to low power states between frames. Trades a little idle wattage for consistent clocks. |
| **Disable CPU idle states (C-States)**<br><sub>`cstates_off`</sub> | 🔴 high |  | Forces the processor to stay in C0. Lowest possible wake latency but noticeably higher idle temps and power draw. |
| **Disable USB selective suspend**<br><sub>`usb_suspend_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Keeps your mouse, keyboard and headset USB ports fully powered — no wake-up hitch after a few seconds idle. |
| **Disable PCI Express link power management**<br><sub>`pcie_aspm_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Keeps PCI Express links (GPU, NVMe) at full power instead of letting Active State Power Management drop them to low-power states. |
| **Disable Fast Startup**<br><sub>`fast_startup_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Fast Startup keeps a stale kernel session across "shutdowns". Disabling it gives true clean boots and fixes many driver oddities. |
| **Disable hibernation (free ~13 GB)**<br><sub>`hibernate_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Deletes hiberfil.sys, which reserves roughly 40% of installed RAM on the system drive. Sleep still works; hibernate does not. |

## Registry Tweaks (9)

Low-level Windows behaviour switches.

| Tweak | Risk | Notes | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Faster shutdown & app kill timeouts**<br><sub>`shutdown_fast`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Cuts WaitToKillService to 2 s, auto-ends hung tasks and shortens the hung-app timeout. |
| **Remove startup app delay**<br><sub>`startup_delay`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ 👤 | Windows waits ~10 s after login before launching startup apps. Set it to zero. |
| **Disable automatic maintenance**<br><sub>`maintenance_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe |  | Stops the idle-time maintenance window (defrag, updates scan, diagnostics) from kicking in while you AFK in a lobby. |
| **Disable Program Compatibility Assistant**<br><sub>`pca_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe |  | PCA watches every program launch to detect "compatibility issues". Disable the service and policy. |
| **Disable Windows Error Reporting**<br><sub>`wer_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | No more crash-dump collection and upload in the background after a game crashes. |
| **Never auto-restart for updates while logged in**<br><sub>`no_auto_reboot`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Windows Update cannot reboot the PC under you while a user session is active. |
| **Optimize Windows Explorer**<br><sub>`explorer_opt`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ 👤 | Open to This PC, show file extensions, hide sync-provider ads and stop tracking recent documents. |
| **Disable Remote Assistance**<br><sub>`remote_assist_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe |  | Closes the Remote Assistance listener nobody on a gaming PC uses. |
| **Classic right-click context menu (Win11)**<br><sub>`classic_context`</sub> | 🟢 safe |  | Brings back the full Windows 10 context menu without the "Show more options" extra click. Restarts Explorer. |

## Windows Debloat (14)

Strip Windows 11 of ads, widgets and preinstalled junk.

| Tweak | Risk | Notes | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Remove preinstalled bloatware apps**<br><sub>`bloat_apps_remove`</sub> | 🟡 medium | ★ | Uninstalls Bing News/Weather, Solitaire, Office Hub, Teams, Clipchamp, Maps, Alarms, Feedback Hub, Zune Music/Video, Skype, 3D Viewer and more for the current user. |
| **Disable consumer features & suggested apps**<br><sub>`consumer_features_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Stops Windows auto-installing Candy Crush / TikTok style "suggested" apps and showing promoted content. |
| **Remove ads from Settings, Start & lock screen**<br><sub>`suggestions_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ 👤 | Turns off every Content Delivery Manager toggle: Start suggestions, Settings tips, lock-screen "fun facts", silent app installs. |
| **Disable Widgets & News feed**<br><sub>`widgets_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Removes the taskbar Widgets board that pre-loads MSN news and weather in the background. |
| **Disable Teams Chat taskbar icon**<br><sub>`chat_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Removes the consumer Teams "Chat" button and stops it auto-launching at login. |
| **Disable Windows Copilot**<br><sub>`copilot_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Removes the Copilot button and blocks the Copilot sidebar via policy. |
| **Disable Search Highlights**<br><sub>`search_highlights_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ 👤 | Stops the taskbar search box fetching daily Bing images and trending topics. |
| **Stop Microsoft Edge running in the background**<br><sub>`edge_background_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Disables Edge Startup Boost and background mode so msedge.exe is not resident when you never opened it. |
| **Uninstall OneDrive**<br><sub>`onedrive_remove`</sub> | 🟡 medium |  | Removes the OneDrive client and blocks it from reinstalling via policy. Your files in the OneDrive folder stay on disk. |
| **Disable Xbox services**<br><sub>`xbox_services_off`</sub> | 🟡 medium |  | Disables Xbox Live Auth, Game Save, Networking and Accessory services. Re-enable if you use Game Pass or Xbox sign-in. |
| **Disable Print Spooler**<br><sub>`print_spooler_off`</sub> | 🟡 medium |  | No printer? The spooler is a resident service and a frequent security target. Disable it. |
| **Disable Fax service**<br><sub>`fax_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Disables the Windows Fax service, which few gaming PCs need. |
| **Disable Windows Insider service**<br><sub>`insider_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Stops the Insider Program service that checks for preview builds. |
| **Disable Delivery Optimization (P2P updates)**<br><sub>`delivery_opt_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Stops your PC uploading Windows Update chunks to strangers and downloading from them. Frees bandwidth and disk. |

## Privacy & Telemetry (10)

Stop Windows phoning home in the background.

| Tweak | Risk | Notes | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Disable Windows telemetry**<br><sub>`telemetry_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Sets diagnostic data to Security-only and disables the DiagTrack and dmwappushservice collectors. |
| **Disable Cortana**<br><sub>`cortana_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Blocks Cortana via policy so it never loads with the search host. |
| **Disable Bing in Start menu search**<br><sub>`bing_search_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ 👤 | Start search stays local — no web results, no keystrokes sent to Bing. |
| **Disable advertising ID**<br><sub>`adv_id_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Stops apps from using a per-user advertising identifier to profile you. |
| **Disable Activity History / Timeline**<br><sub>`activity_history_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Windows stops logging which apps and files you use and stops uploading that log to Microsoft. |
| **Disable location tracking**<br><sub>`location_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe |  | Denies location access system-wide and disables the location platform. |
| **Disable feedback requests**<br><sub>`feedback_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | No more "How likely are you to recommend Windows?" prompts and feedback notifications. |
| **Disable tailored experiences**<br><sub>`tailored_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ 👤 | Stops Microsoft using your diagnostic data to personalise tips, ads and recommendations. |
| **Disable Remote Registry**<br><sub>`remote_registry_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Nobody should be editing your registry over the network. |
| **Disable LLMNR name resolution**<br><sub>`llmnr_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe |  | Turns off multicast name resolution — a chatty, spoofable legacy protocol. |

## Network & Ping (6)

Lower latency, faster DNS, tighter TCP stack.

| Tweak | Risk | Notes | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Disable Nagle's algorithm**<br><sub>`nagle_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ⟳ ★ | Sends small TCP packets immediately instead of batching them. Helps TCP-based games and launchers; most shooters use UDP and are unaffected. |
| **Disable network throttling**<br><sub>`net_throttle_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Windows rate-limits non-multimedia network traffic to 10 packets/ms. Set NetworkThrottlingIndex to off. |
| **Optimize TCP stack for gaming**<br><sub>`tcp_optimize`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Disables RSC, ECN and TCP timestamps, sets normal auto-tuning and CTCP congestion control. |
| **Use Cloudflare DNS (1.1.1.1)**<br><sub>`dns_cloudflare`</sub> | 🟡 medium |  | Sets Cloudflare (1.1.1.1) as the DNS resolver on every active adapter. Speeds up name lookups on many ISPs, not game ping. Revert restores DHCP-assigned DNS. |
| **Stop Windows powering down the network adapter**<br><sub>`net_adapter_power`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Clears "Allow the computer to turn off this device to save power" on every NIC. |
| **Disable NIC interrupt moderation & flow control**<br><sub>`net_offloads`</sub> | 🟡 medium |  | Interrupt moderation batches packets to save CPU at the cost of a little latency. Disabling it delivers packets immediately. Only applies to adapters that expose these settings. |

## Storage & Memory (11)

NTFS, paging and RAM management for SSD systems with 16 GB+.

| Tweak | Risk | Notes | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Keep the kernel resident in RAM**<br><sub>`mem_mgmt`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ⟳ ★ | Keeps kernel code in RAM (DisablePagingExecutive) and favours application memory over the file cache. |
| **Disable memory compression**<br><sub>`mem_compression_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | On systems with 16 GB or more, compressing standby memory pages spends CPU time for little benefit. Disables it. |
| **Disable page combining**<br><sub>`page_combining_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Stops the memory manager from periodically scanning RAM for identical pages to merge. Useful on systems with plenty of RAM. |
| **Disable application pre-launch**<br><sub>`prelaunch_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe |  | Windows pre-launches Store apps it guesses you will open. Turn it off so RAM and disk go only to what you run. |
| **Disable Prefetch & Superfetch (SSD)**<br><sub>`prefetch_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ⟳ | Prefetch mostly benefits spinning disks. On an SSD-only system it adds background tracing for little gain. |
| **Disable SysMain service**<br><sub>`sysmain_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | SysMain (Superfetch) preloads frequently used apps into RAM and can cause background disk activity. Little benefit on SSD systems. |
| **Disable NTFS last-access timestamps**<br><sub>`ntfs_lastaccess`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Every file read no longer triggers a metadata write. Less SSD wear, faster file access. |
| **Increase NTFS paged-pool memory**<br><sub>`ntfs_memusage`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ⟳ ★ | Lets NTFS keep more metadata cached in paged-pool memory (fsutil memoryusage 2). Best on systems with 16 GB or more. |
| **Disable legacy 8.3 filename creation**<br><sub>`ntfs_8dot3`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ⟳ | Stops NTFS generating DOS-style short names for every new file. Faster directory operations. |
| **Ensure SSD TRIM is enabled**<br><sub>`trim_on`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ | Verifies DeleteNotify is on so the SSD controller can garbage-collect freed blocks. |
| **Disable Windows Search indexing**<br><sub>`wsearch_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe |  | Stops the indexer from crawling your drives in the background. Start-menu file search becomes slower. |

## Visual & UI (6)

Turn off eye candy that steals frames.

| Tweak | Risk | Notes | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Disable window animations & visual effects**<br><sub>`animations_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ 👤 | Best-performance visual settings: no window fade, no taskbar animation, no menu slide. Sign out to fully apply. |
| **Disable transparency effects**<br><sub>`transparency_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ 👤 | Acrylic blur on the taskbar and Start menu is rendered by the GPU every frame. Turn it off. |
| **Instant menus (MenuShowDelay 0)**<br><sub>`menu_delay`</sub> | 🟢 safe | ★ 👤 | Context menus and submenus open with zero delay. |
| **Disable Aero Shake**<br><sub>`aero_shake_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | 👤 | Stops windows minimising when you shake one by the title bar. |
| **Skip the lock screen**<br><sub>`lockscreen_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe |  | Boots straight to the password prompt instead of the Spotlight lock screen image. |
| **Show icons instead of thumbnails**<br><sub>`thumbnails_off`</sub> | 🟢 safe | 👤 | Explorer stops generating image and video thumbnails, which avoids disk activity when browsing large folders. |

## Boost-ups

One-shot maintenance actions. These are not reversible toggles.

| Boost-up | Category | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **Junk & Temp Cleaner**<br><sub>`temp_clean`</sub> | system | Clears user and system temp folders, Windows Update download cache and the delivery-optimization cache. |
| **Shader Cache Rebuild**<br><sub>`shader_cache`</sub> | gaming | Wipes the NVIDIA DXCache/GLCache and the Windows D3DSCache so corrupt or bloated shader caches are rebuilt fresh. |
| **Flush DNS & Reset Winsock**<br><sub>`dns_flush`</sub> | network | Clears the DNS resolver cache and resets the Winsock catalog. Fixes stale lookups and odd connection issues. |
| **Free Standby Memory**<br><sub>`standby_list`</sub> | gaming | Trims working sets of every process and clears the file-cache standby list, returning RAM to games instantly. |
| **Empty Recycle Bin**<br><sub>`recycle_bin`</sub> | system | Permanently deletes everything in the Recycle Bin on all drives. |
| **Prefetch & Thumbnail Cache**<br><sub>`prefetch_clean`</sub> | system | Clears stale Prefetch traces and the Explorer thumbnail/icon caches, fixing blank or wrong icons. |
| **Clear Event Logs**<br><sub>`event_logs`</sub> | system | Wipes all Windows event logs. Useful before troubleshooting; frees a little space. |
| **SSD ReTrim / Optimize Drives**<br><sub>`ssd_trim`</sub> | hardware | Runs Optimize-Volume with ReTrim on every SSD and a quick defrag analysis on any HDD. |
| **Reset Windows Update Cache**<br><sub>`wu_cache`</sub> | system | Stops update services, deletes SoftwareDistribution and catroot2, restarts services. Fixes stuck updates. |
| **Steam Cleaner**<br><sub>`steam_clean`</sub> | gaming | Removes Steam HTTP cache, shader cache and crash dumps. Installed games and saves are not touched. |
| **Restart Explorer & Reset Taskbar**<br><sub>`restart_explorer`</sub> | system | Restarts explorer.exe to apply UI tweaks and fix a frozen taskbar. |
| **Reset GPU Driver (Ctrl+Shift+Win+B)**<br><sub>`gpu_reset`</sub> | hardware | Issues the graphics driver reset signal — clears a black screen / stuck display without rebooting. |
| **Create System Restore Point**<br><sub>`restore_point`</sub> | system | Creates a restore point named "Event Horizon" so you can roll back everything in one click. |
